_comment: ComfyUI API-format workflow for HiDream-I1 Dev GGUF (Q5_K_M) text-to-image. Same 17B DiT+MoE model as hidream-i1-dev-t2i-api-template.json, but the diffusion weights are Q5_K_M-quantised (~13.5GB rather than ~17GB), which is what makes HiDream-I1 fit a 16GB card without offloading. Only the UNet is quantised -- the four text encoders (clip-g, clip-l, t5xxl, llama-3.1-8b) stay safetensors and load through the ordinary QuadrupleCLIPLoader, so this needs --hidream for the encoders and VAE as well as --hidream-gguf for the checkpoint. Requires the ComfyUI-GGUF custom node (github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF), which the Dockerfile installs; note that a pre-existing comfyui_custom_nodes volume shadows the image's copy, so if UnetLoaderGGUF is missing, remove that volume and recreate the stack rather than rebuilding. cfg must be 1.0 -- Dev is guidance-distilled and the official docs pass no negative prompt, so node 5 is inert but stays because KSampler requires a negative input. 28 steps matches the Dev schedule; the Fast variant wants 16. Unlike HiDream-O1, this is a latent-space model with a normal VAE, so 1024x1024 is its native resolution and there is no reason to raise it. Swap node 1 to UnetLoaderGGUFAdvanced if you need to control dequant_dtype/patch_dtype. Replace PROMPT_TEXT, WIDTH, HEIGHT, SEED, and FILENAME_PREFIX as needed.
